name: Nissa
source:
A girl that Shar meets in the marketplace of the big city, Nissa acts like a bit of a rogue. She is quick to decide she wants to be Shar's friend. She will show Shar around the city, share the local gossip, and want to learn everyone's juicy secrets.

[From [url=https://www.rollingcrown.com/ice_demon/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Salome Rynn.[/spoiler]
